【原视频简介】
CPU, GPU, RAM, SSD, PSU — every part inside your PC explained in plain English, no tech degree needed.

This video breaks down every core PC component like a team inside one office: the CPU is the brain making the decisions, RAM is the desk holding what you're working on right now, and storage is the filing cabinet keeping everything safe for later. You'll see why 16GB of RAM shrugs off dozens of Chrome tabs while 8GB feels tight, why switching from a hard drive to an SSD can cut boot time from a full minute down to just a few seconds, and how the GPU, motherboard, PSU, cooling, and case all work together to keep that team running smoothly. We also cover the one idea that matters most when upgrading — bottlenecks — so you never waste money on the wrong part again.
